title: Literary Participles (-ván/-vén) in Elevated Prose
goal: I can recognize and form the high-register causal-anterior participle in -ván/-vén (tudván, látván, lévén)
I can use -ván/-vén clauses to express a reason or prior realization that motivates the main clause
I can use B2 vocabulary of artistic inspiration, vision, and inner transformation
